competence_screen.checkpoint_rule: Largest full-validation AUROC; exact AUROC ties use lower validation NLL, then earlier epoch. Save and restore the selected state. Never evaluate TEST in the loop.
competence_screen.architecture_rule: Largest mean selected validation AUROC across three seeds; exact ties use lower mean validation NLL, fewer native active parameters, then config id. Select once using native singles only.

provisional_eligibility_rule: All three selected native fits have finite forward values and gradients, TRAIN NLL below the TRAIN class-prior NLL, and full-validation AUROC above .5.
Mean native full-validation AUROC is no more than .02 below the ordinary feature MLP mean. The .02 tolerance is ours, not an author/published performance threshold.

falsification_and_reporting: Native failure to learn competently blocks geometry/private-diversity conclusions; no claimed negative result from a broken baseline.
Always compare candidate pooling with its mean member score and best member, the native single, and the genuine independent native ensemble. Report cost and own-task quality alongside diversity.
If assignment controls recover candidate quality, persistent edge correspondence is not established as necessary under this protocol.
If layer-shared capacity recovers candidate quality, edge-conditioned private matrices are replaceable by node capacity under this protocol.

If a capable joint multi-transport single matches/replaces the candidate, this weakens an ensemble-specific explanation. It already has all four transport states; its extra capacity and cost are explicit.

Predictive disagreement or map-parameter movement alone is insufficient. Report member TRAIN/VALIDATION quality, error overlap, probability covariance, pooled improvement, and native effective normalized transport differences on label-blind graph samples.

Native learner .L is detached unnormalized negative lower-triangle transport. It cannot stand in for the final normalized/clamped effective block. Any loop/gauge diagnostic must separately capture the actual effective operator without changing source propagation.
